use_cases.name: ED arrival forecasting
use_cases.decision_origin: Scheduled forecast origin after available ED history cutoff
use_cases.algorithms: Seasonal naive; negative-binomial GLM; pooled LightGBM Poisson; Prophet optional benchmark
use_cases.feature_rules: Known calendar and lagged visible arrivals; future realized weather/respiratory excluded
use_cases.label: Forecast time interval counts; aggregation consistent across hospital/hour/day
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: Inpatient admissions
use_cases.decision_origin: Scheduled forecast origin with source-visible admissions history
use_cases.algorithms: Seasonal naive; pooled negative-binomial GLM / LightGBM
use_cases.feature_rules: Historical elective/emergency mix only. All 4800 elective booking exports late; no booked schedule feature
use_cases.label: New admissions after origin excluding carry-in; sum service lines without duplicating transfers
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: Bed occupancy/census
use_cases.decision_origin: Forecast origin with corrected bed state and visible M2/M4 inputs
use_cases.algorithms: Stock-flow Monte Carlo champion; quantile LightGBM challenger only with support
use_cases.feature_rules: M2 forecast inflows; completed-stay LOS prior known at origin for new arrivals; conditional remaining-LOS distribution for currently active eligible patients; fallback prior for ineligible active cases
use_cases.label: Physical occupied beds cannot exceed active licensed physical capacity; staffedcapacity shortfall never erases existingpatients and is reported separately. Model unplaced demand inqueue; avoid force-fitting occupancytostaffingcapacity.
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: Remaining inpatient LOS
use_cases.decision_origin: First instant all required IPD inputs visible, at least admission+1h45 on this release; still active at origin
use_cases.algorithms: Conditional survival/AFT baseline; Cox/LightGBM survival challenger
use_cases.feature_rules: Only visible fields at origin; condition on elapsed stay and still admitted. No discharged_at/disposition/medically_ready_at or future test results
use_cases.label: Remaining time discharged_at - origin, not total LOS; ongoing stays right-censored; completed before visibility -> ALREADY_RESOLVED
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: Discharge within 24 hours
use_cases.decision_origin: First whole UTC hour at/after M4 eligibility, continuing hourly while active
use_cases.feature_rules: No medically-ready flag: none of 11107 such records available before discharge; no future outcomes
use_cases.label: Discharge in (origin,origin+24h]; completed before/equal origin -> ALREADY_RESOLVED
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: Staffing demand
use_cases.decision_origin: M3 forecast issuance with versioned generation rule
use_cases.algorithms: Derived, not learned: source base5.5 RN productive HPPD × configured acuity weights (1:1.12,2:1.04,3–5:1.00) on M3 forecast shift-start census mix × actual elapsedshift hours/24. MinimumoneRN per activeACUTE/ICU/ED scope; preserve ACUTE MEDICINE/SURGERY pooling. Version full/partial roster translation separately; source nominal12h productivecapacity=elapsedhours−1.25 including DST11/13h.
use_cases.feature_rules: Use observed/source-visible acuitymix or forecastcohortmix; future actualacuity/census forbidden. ED/OR/case/support coverage only within selectedcapturedscope; no fullhospitalscheduling/safestaffingclaim. Fixedinputrule does not mean observedHPPD is constant.
use_cases.label: Forecast productive-hour demand and interval under versionedsourcebase/acuity/minimumrules; compare available roster hours separately. Minimumcoverage/fullandpartialshift rounding make observedHPPD variable; never train an8.0constant rule.
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: RN absence volume
use_cases.decision_origin: Weekly origin with known shift/attendance history
use_cases.algorithms: Seasonal naive / pooled Poisson GLM; no rare overtime model
use_cases.feature_rules: Only latest visible shift revision and legitimate attendance states
use_cases.label: Future absent shift count, not missing-source-file count
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: Inventory consumption
use_cases.decision_origin: Daily origin after visible signed movements
use_cases.algorithms: Croston/TSB intermittent baseline; pooled LightGBM if sufficient signal
use_cases.feature_rules: Exactly 9 consuming items eligible; future patient-days from M3 forecasts, not realized census
use_cases.label: Future consumption base units; transfers/receipts/adjustments not demand
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: Cash collections
use_cases.decision_origin: Weekly origin with visible claim/remittance ledger
use_cases.algorithms: Historical lag-distribution cashflow; seasonal naive; SARIMAX residual optional if support
use_cases.feature_rules: Current pending AR and historically visible cash/cohort lag; no future adjudication
use_cases.label: Future receipt-week signed cash flow; opening balances not a new receipt
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: Original-claim denial risk and volume
use_cases.grain_horizon: pending original claim at first eligible snapshot; payer/month volume
use_cases.decision_origin: First available claim snapshot strictly before its first adjudication; cannot score at first_submitted_at because all 57818 headers become visible later
use_cases.algorithms: Logistic baseline; LightGBM for risk; pooled ETS/naive denied-volume baseline
use_cases.feature_rules: Use only fields actually visible before first adjudication, no denial code/adjudication/remittance amounts. attempt_no models original claim event history; resubmissions not new claims; SELF_PAY internal responsibility confirmation is not external payer adjudication.
use_cases.label: Original insured non-carry-in claim_id; first attempt_no=1 event_type in (ADJUDICATED,DENIED) establishes target outcome time. Any attempt1 DENIED line at that outcome makes originalclaim positive once, including partialdenial; attempt2 appeal/recovery notnewclaim. Exclude SELF_PAY statements. Origin strictly before earliest initial outcome event and its visibleknowledge; header required. Resolved/noauditablewindow -> ALREADY_RESOLVED/INELIGIBLE.
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: Appointment no-show
use_cases.decision_origin: No valid prospective origin in this release; all 25800 outcomes exported after scheduled start
use_cases.algorithms: Descriptive segmentation only; no production prospective model
use_cases.feature_rules: No pretending booked_at means exported/known early; any research classifier clearly post-outcome and never deployed
use_cases.label: No online endpoint or previsit risk claim
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: 30-day readmission
use_cases.decision_origin: First discharge snapshot visible after business discharge, provided still within discharge+30d and no readmission already observed by origin
use_cases.feature_rules: Only fields visible by first eligible discharge origin; known readmission -> ALREADY_RESOLVED; delayed release may produce INELIGIBLE, never backdate origin
use_cases.label: First unplanned IPD readmission in (origin,discharge+30d]; horizon measured from index discharge; full source/export-visible follow-up required; no claim of score at instantaneous discharge
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

use_cases.name: Financial forecast
use_cases.decision_origin: Monthly origin with published vintage and posting availability cutoff
use_cases.feature_rules: 36 monthly observations only; no per-series deep network, future Axiom vintages or retrospective ACTUAL leakage
use_cases.label: Selected currency/unit actual measure; horizons 1/2/3 reported separately; 12m insufficient for validated enterprise annual forecast
use_cases.support_status: Design eligibility only; measure eligible cohorts and event counts in Phase 8. Fail to BASELINE_ONLY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA if thresholds fail; no automatic claim of trained model success.

forbidden_inputs: Post-adjudication denial codes/cash as original-denial-risk inputs

split_policy.selection: M1–M12 train2023–2024, select at rollingJan–Jun2025origins, freeze then untouchedJul–Dec2025test; no testtuning. Demo finalrefit separatelylabelled and retainsheldoutartifact.
split_policy.maturity: An example belongs to a split only if its entire target/follow-up interval AND target source/export availability are within the split's end. Calendar year boundaries do not waive delayed label availability. Purge 30d M12, 24h M5, horizon-specific 1â€“84d forecasts and variable full LOS labels; censor survival observations explicitly.
split_policy.overlap: Each immutable example ID/origin belongs to one split; group repeated snapshots by encounter/episode and prohibit patient/outcome leakage across supervised classification partitions where linked. Forecasting uses strictly time-forward rolling origins with lag history available at origin; patient grouping never removes aggregate demand from labels.
split_policy.monthly: M13 pre2025rollingselection, fitthroughDecember2024, untouchedall2025test. Horizon1–3 needs>=3independenttargets/horizon;12monthsinglefull2025origin exploratoryonly. No annualforecastvalidation claim from oneorigin.
split_policy.late_exports: No decision beyond 2025-12-31 used to manufacture extra test origins. Retained boundary exports may mature earlier labels only if allowed by split cutoff; otherwise mark censored/unscorable.

minimum_support.sparse_policy: Pool clinically sensible units/payers only with a documented grouping; retain sparse strata with INSUFFICIENT_DATA and confidence intervals. Do not manufacture labels or claim all 13 are trained.

promotion.rule: Baseline may be champion. Challenger requires >=5% improvement in primary validation loss, no material calibration/conservation degradation, supported facility/horizon slices and reproducible price within allowance. Held-out test reports performance after selection, never retunes threshold.
promotion.interval: 80%intervalcoverage75–85% supportedstrata with samplecounts/blockawareCI; classifierECE<=0.05 plus>=200heldoutcases and30positive/negative atdeclaredgrain. Underpoweredcasesrestricted/insufficient, neverclaimcalibrated.
promotion.neural: LSTM/transformers excluded by default: 3 years/low daily counts do not support unvalidated complexity. Explicit evidence/cost revision required to add.

online_contract.phase13: M4 on simulated eligible active inpatient state uses the same 1h45 availability contract plus actual serving-ready cutoff. Evaluate early/at-boundary/delayed-copy/resolved cases; unsupported products abstain.

staffing_rule_provenance.roster_translation: Source-style maxone full shift, floor full demand/productivecapacity and optional partial extra whenresidual>=3h; preserve elapsed11/12/13h. Predict productive demand first; any alternative ceil-headcount planning scenario is separatelyversioned and not claimed identical sourceattendance.
